lanes.scope: Execute only the separately governed Pass 12 release-gate Rego source and its native test.
lanes.authority_boundary: Passing this bounded Rego pair does not establish a repository-wide evaluator, bundle admission, PolicyDecision emission, source admission, release, or publication authority.

lanes.scope: Regenerate deterministic fixtures into an isolated output and compare declared digests.
lanes.hold_reason: No accepted repository-wide fixture regeneration producer and closed digest manifest exist.
lanes.authority_boundary: Fixture generation cannot admit sources, overwrite reviewed fixtures, publish, or convert generated bytes into evidence without separate review.

lanes.scope: Run the bounded synthetic Hydrology proof slice from digest-pinned fixtures without network access.
lanes.authority_boundary: A synthetic proof-slice PASS cannot admit a live source, emit a PolicyDecision, approve a release candidate, publish, deploy, or satisfy independent review by itself.

lanes.scope: Build catalog candidates only from validated processed outputs under a declared profile.
lanes.hold_reason: No accepted executable catalog builder and input-selection profile exist.
lanes.authority_boundary: Catalog candidate generation cannot admit, release, publish, deploy, or overwrite authoritative catalog records.
